item.title: Trump says his D.C. arch will serve as 'military complex' with snipers and drones
item.description: President Trump has claimed that military operations are needed at his proposed triumphal arch in Washington D.C., in order to protect national security. A federal court is weighing the arch's legality.

item.title: A program in a Texas prison teaches incarcerated women to transcribe braille
item.description: The job market is tougher for those with a criminal record. But a Texas women's prison offers inmates skills in braille transcription that could help them support themselves when they are released.

item.title: Xi Jinping is coming to the White House. Here's what to expect
item.description: Xi Jinping arrives in the US this week for an important summit with President Trump. We look at what President Trump and the Chinese leader want out of this visit.

item.title: In New Orleans, an empty building becomes a free store — and roller skating rink
item.description: In the Lower Ninth Ward, an old Family Dollar stands covered in graffiti. It looks abandoned. But inside, it's a treasure trove — clothing, home goods, toys and books. And everything is free.

item.title: Thousands of planned launches, terms of deal, worry some near Louisiana SpaceX site

item.title: DEI and colleges
item.description: The President of Sacramento State talks about their Black honors college -- and how schools are dealing with DEI under the Trump administration. This story was produced with support from the Education Writers Association's Reporting Fellowship program.
